title: Grand Ole Opry HoF House
description:
Best-kept secret in Nashville! Stay in a place of country music history.  This historic Hall of Fame home is on 2 spacious acres is just a mile from the Grand Ole Opry and 10 minutes from downtown. Enjoy plush king beds in a large open house meant for socializing, with a secluded feel.   This house is only minutes from EVERYTHING Nashville has to offer. You will not be disappointed!

Other things to note
The basement apartment is occupied with no access to the main house.
